setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: The project at the end of chapter 7: channel 1 plays degrees 0, 0, 0, 1 from pattern 1 with step 13 at velocity 50, channel 2 plays its bass, and C major is applied. Step 15 has no trig. Playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Choose pattern 1, tap (15,4) on Pattern Trig to add a trig on step 15, press Pattern (5,8) once to open the note view and tap (15,7) for degree 0. PATTERN NOTE PAT01 CH01 shows the tooltip Step 15 note set to 0 and a trig stripe on steps 1, 5, 9, 13 and 15.
steps.title: Add the late trig

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), turn E1 right three detents to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Masks and press K3. NOTE MASKS CH01 shows Note X (the pattern notes decide pitch), Vel 80 and Len 1/2: the channel defaults the new trig will use until you give step 15 its own velocity.
steps.title: Open Masks

steps.caption: Select Vel with E2, hold (15,4) and turn E3 left 45 detents until Vel reads 35. While you hold the step, NOTE MASKS CH01 ST15 shows Vel 35, that step's own value. Keep holding for this frame, then release (15,4).
steps.title: Set step 15 to velocity 35

steps.caption: After you release, the screen shows the channel default Vel 80 again. Play two passes and stop. While it plays the Play pad (1,8) is lit and a dim playhead cell moves along row 4. The MIDI strip shows the phrase (60 at velocity 80, then 62 at 50) and a quiet 60 at velocity 35 on step 15, just before the bar restarts.
steps.title: Hear the quiet pickup
